messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you doing this week? Any readings to log, or anything going on health-wise you want me to know about?

BP was 138/88 this morning. Bigger problem is I'm almost out of lisinopril and my doctor said I need a new script before they'll refill it. Nearest pharmacy is 47 miles and the roads aren't great right now.

Got it — logging that 138/88 reading now. On the lisinopril: refills and new prescriptions are outside what I can handle, but running low on a blood pressure medication is a clinical issue and I'm flagging it for the nursing team right now. Fair warning, median response time is currently 31 hours, so someone should be in touch by tomorrow. They'll know the situation when they reach out.
What about getting a ride out there? Is that something you can set up?

Transportation isn't something I'm able to arrange — that's not in my lane yet. The nurse following up on your script might know what local options exist, or your county may have a medical transport line worth calling. I know that's not the answer you were hoping for.
Ok. Just don't want to miss doses. Go ahead and set up next week's check-in.
Next check-in is scheduled. The care team has your flag — missing doses on a blood pressure med is exactly why I escalated it. Hope you hear back well before you run out.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
